_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for LOW retrospectives (retro/build_low.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time, US Eastern). The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF, the prints published by AS_OF that report a fiscal year after that history (a Q4 print reports the year just ended and extends the history until the 10-K), each field of the latest guide for the current fiscal year published by AS_OF, the latest dividend declaration, and the events published between that vintage and AS_OF. Lowe's fiscal year N ends on the Friday nearest January 31 of N+1. Values are as reported, per share on the basis of the filing that published them; a vintage takes each year from the latest 10-K that reports it, and eps_published / shares_published give such a year's own publication date, so a stock split ('splits') restates exactly the per-share facts published before its effective date. Guides come from each release's 'Business Outlook' (next quarter and fiscal year) and from 8-Ks; margin_def names the margin a guide steps: 'operating margin' (gross margin less SG&A and depreciation, to the Q3 FY07 release) or 'EBIT margin' (from the Q4 FY07 release). A print's margins and the vintage's prev_fy_margins carry both, derived from the published percent-of-sales column. Edit only to add newly published facts or fix a transcription error against the cited filing.
